AMENDMENT_JSON.title: Amendment 3 — Delivery and Certification Change
AMENDMENT_JSON.text: This amendment supersedes Section B paragraph 3. Delivery is changed from 45 days to 30 days ARO. Additionally, offerors MUST provide ISO 13485 certification with their proposal. Page limit remains 10 pages.

notes: Should detect delivery reduction and new mandatory certification. Page limit is confirmed unchanged.
